role: Real Zone of Possible Agreement math (Fisher & Ury) — genuine negotiation theory, not fabricated psychology. Honestly returns null when the other party's max acceptable point isn't known, rather than guessing. Assembles a fixed set of response-scenario branches, always all of them, no selection.
behaviorDescription: prepareNegotiation() computes real ZOPA math verified against a real-ZOPA case, a no-ZOPA case, and the unknown case before implementation. Assembles a prompt covering all five real response scenarios (accept/counter_higher/counter_lower/add_condition/walk_away). Never generates the actual counter-strategy content itself — that needs a live LLM, same honest limit as E-01/E-09.
hardStops: Never fabricates a value for the other party's max acceptable point when it's genuinely unknown — reports it as unknown
Never recommends a counter-offer outside the person's own stated minimum
